summary: Followed the bug report to packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts. In ensureInventoryLevels (lines 173-192), the validateQuantityAtLocation loop checks each batch entry against the same un-decremented level.available_quantity, so multiple entries for one inventory item+location in a single createReservationItems call are never summed before the stock check. createReservationItems_ then writes the summed adjustment (lines 279-290), so reserved quantity can exceed stock. I submitted one attempt (a single cart with two lines sharing WIDGET, 12 units needed vs 10 stocked) expecting a no_oversell failure. I have not yet seen that attempt's run results, so the claim rests on the code reading rather than a confirmed reproduction.
